text:
ria: Quick heads-up — scheduling a small schema switch for orders_v3 tomorrow 03/25 00:30 UTC. Plan: enable dual-write for 30m, then run backfill. Need smoke owner, rollback owner, and a short warm-up step. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orders-schema-switch

cj: I can take smoke. I’ll run the smoke script and validate read-after-write on a few routes.

devon: I’ll own rollback. Two quick Qs: estimated backfill time for ~10M rows? and do we have an incremental resume flag?

sita: Backfill should be ~45–60m last time with batch=5k. We should pre-warm indexes and materialized views. Quick warmup SQL: `SELECT id FROM orders_v2 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10000;` hits the index pages.

maria: Traffic plan: gradual shift via canaries — 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Wait for 5m stable at each step. Also enable request sampling for payload validation.

cj: Smoke checklist (short):
- kick off migration job `python migrations/run.py --schema orders_v3 --mode dual-write`
- run `./scripts/smoke-orders.sh` (reads + writes)
- check Prometheus: orders_api_error_rate, p99 latency, db_repl_lag
- verify consumer queues (orders-events) have 0 backpressure
- confirm no increase in 5xx from canaries

leo: Slot booked 00:30–01:30 UTC. Oncall @sam notified. Sam, can you be on the call for rollback decision if needed?

sam: Yep I'll be oncall and watching dashboards. My thresholds: >5% errors or db_repl_lag > 30s => pause and rollback. Ping me in thread.

devon: Rollback plan sketch: 1) pause write switch, 2) revert service routing to v2, 3) disable dual-write job, 4) safely rehydrate anything missed. Expect 15–30m to fully rollback depending on consumer catchup.

ria: Backfill command (for reference):
```
python backfill.py --table orders_v3 --batch-size 5000 --workers 8 --resume
```
Will post job link once created.

sita: Also add a pre-check step: run `SELECT count(*) FROM orders_v2 WHERE created_at > '2026-03-01';` to ensure no huge surprise delta.

maria: Monitoring endpoints: https://grafana.redwood/apps/orders-dashboard and https://grafana.redwood/d/db-replica/replica-lag

deploy-bot: Reminder: run `./ops/run-smoke.sh` 15m before slot. Tag deploy with `#orders-schema-2318902468`.

cj: All set for smoke owner. I'll run the smoke script and post results back here. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're good with the plan and window.

leo: :thumbsup: from me.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll be on standby.

devon: :thumbsup: rollback ready.

ria: Thanks all — I'll create the migration job and post the job id + canary traffic plan in this thread ~1h before window.

ops-bot: Note: backup snapshot scheduled at 00:00 UTC (full DB snapshot).

ria: Closing loop — if anything changes ping in #eng-platform and @sam.
